description.value: Spokes Bicycle Rentals is Vancouver's longest-running and largest bike rental company, founded in 1938 and family-owned ever since. The Waterfront location at 870 Cordova St. West sits steps from Canada Place and the official start of the Stanley Park Seawall, placing cyclists directly at the entry point of one of the world's most celebrated urban cycling routes. Spokes also sells professionally maintained used bikes from Trek and Giant, each backed by a 30-day mechanical guarantee.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM node at 870 West Cordova Street is 'Spokes Waterfront,' the newer secondary location of Spokes Bicycle Rentals, distinct from the flagship at 1798 W. Georgia St. The site provides extensive evidence of a large, active rental fleet and used bike sales with professional tune-ups, but contains no explicit mention of walk-in mechanical repairs for visiting cyclists, pump access, washrooms, or most other WWC amenities beyond rentals. The phone number 604.688.5141 appears clearly on the website but was absent from the OSM record.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Spokes Waterfront is an active, well-established bike rental shop at the start of the Stanley Park Seawall — one of Vancouver's premier cycling tourism destinations — with a large and modern rental fleet that is highly relevant to visiting cyclists.

Bike rentals.detail: Extensive fleet including step-thru and step-over cruisers (1spd and 7spd), city hybrids (21spd), mountain bikes, Step-Thru and Step-Over E Cruisers (30–65 km range), e-scooters, tandems, junior mountain bikes, child trailers, child seats, trail-a-bikes, and dog baskets. All available at the Spokes Waterfront location
